content: CHD1, or Chromodomain-helicase-DNA-binding protein 1, is an enzyme in humans that is encoded by the CHD1 gene. Proteins in the CHD family are defined by the presence of chromo domains, which are chromatin organization modifier domains, as well as SNF2-related helicase/ATPase domains. These CHD genes are thought to influence gene expression by modifying the structure of chromatin. This modification can alter the accessibility of the transcriptional machinery to the chromosomal DNA template, thereby regulating transcriptional activity. CHD1 has been demonstrated to interact with Nuclear receptor co-repressor 1, suggesting a role in transcriptional repression or chromatin remodeling processes.
